text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Billiards—
a puzzle combining one's body and 
mind… I called you here today because I knew
you 
would make for a worthy opponent…

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
However,
you're stronger than I could have ever 
imagined—a true nightmare!
An immovable sniper! 
You have truly blown past all of my
expectations!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Properly executed collision and
trajectory 
leading to a pocket. Perfectly executed.
Hmph, 
this isn't so bad.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Proper body manipulation is required 
for this game, and may help with racing. 
I thank you for inviting me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! I humbly accept your words,
and thank you 
as well for attending.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
However,
our pleasure has only just begun. Do 
you not hear it?
The sound of Gaia wailing for 
even more splendor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: So, you would like a rematch?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
With every destruction comes rebirth, 
and with every rebirth comes destruction! 
Super Trick Shot!

Tanino Gimlet hits the cue ball to begin
the 
match,
swiftly sinking one after another. Soon, 
only one ball remained.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: It'll be my victory once I pocket this!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Gimlet… There's a hole… in the wall.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Looks as though my impulsiveness 
has resulted in the end of that play. 
Shall we begin act two of our holiday— 
Of Apologies And Reparations?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: How long can you continue accelerating for?! My lungs are burning and my legs hurt so much, yet she seems to be enjoying herself!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ngh! I can't lose, I won't lose! I need to push past her, my limits, and everything else standing in my way!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I need to go faster, faster, faster, and faster! I can go so much faster! The path forward is much more free!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hey, C.B… we were running 
solo at first, weren't we?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yup. I'm not really sure how or when,
but we 
started competing against one another.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Wait, where are we?!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
It sure is easy to get lost when you get 
absorbed into running, huh? Well,
as long as we 
walk back we'll eventually make it back
home.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hold on,
wait a second! Don't just walk away 
from me! We need to get up somewhere high!
C.B., 
let's go climb up that cliff!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hmm? That's pretty unconventional, huh?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I don't wanna hear that from you!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I figured I'd know where you were,
but no matter 
where I checked I couldn't find you. It's 
already gotten so late…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …but I'm glad I found you, Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
My, it's good to see you.
But I did not ask for 
you to look for me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You know I couldn't leave you alone. 
Now can you tell me why…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Why do you refuse to return home after
your 
races? Even more so when you display an 
immaculate performance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Now now,
Miss Emperor. Does it bother you when 
you aren't in control of everything?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That was not my intention. I simply 
dislike staying out all night,
but regardless 
I'll proceed with the formal paperwork 
to allow you to do so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I don't need permission.
More importantly, 
you're wise. You likely already 
know why I do this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Because of your unparalleled love for racing.
At least that's what it seems like on the
surface. 
However,
you're still an unknown variable to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
Spoken like a true ally of justice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I need nothing but the turf.
As long as I can 
love that, I need nothing more. However…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
When one burns hotter than the sun,
the only 
thing that can cool them down is the cool
night 
sky. The past is simply a hindrance to my
love.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ramonu headed back to the dormitory.
Sorry 
it took so long. I'll be back soon,
but feel 
free to head back to sleep, alright? Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Wait,
there's more students that haven't come 
back yet? That's… no,
it shouldn't be a problem. 
I'll go and bring them back.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Nngh! Apollo,
how dare you?! As he swung his 
mallet, he chased the darkness away.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You two are quite late.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. We are past curfew because we were 
repairing a wall.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Wooah!!
We're finally back on a familiar road!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, I'm so exhausted. Wait,
hmm? What're those 
girls up to? Going for a walk?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Nah, looks like they're writing formal 
apologies… Dangit!
I was hoping we'd get back 
into the dorms without them seeing us too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Looks like everyone's back. I'd like 
to say "where in the world have you
been?", 
but they all look so exhausted so I guess 
I'll hold off for now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now why don't we head home? It's going 
to be morning soon, and with it will 
come one more beautiful day.
